name: osrs
description: Old School RuneScape tools for agents: hiscores, live GE prices, wiki data, Wise Old Man, drop odds, boss value, shop arbitrage, market movers, daily, weekly, and seasonal price cycles, backtesting, investment tracking, price-action investigation, crafting trees, quest requirements, and training plans. Requires the osrs CLI.

user_agent.title: User-Agent
user_agent.description: Identifies you to the OSRS Wiki, Jagex, and Wise Old Man, such as 'my-tools - @name on Discord'. Leave empty to use the go-osrs default.

wom_api_key.title: Wise Old Man API key
wom_api_key.description: Optional. Raises the Wise Old Man rate limit above 20 requests a minute.
